result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so I haven't run your Anna/Bob example.

In `DataStore.java`, the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of `CustomerAttributedRecords` now has the exclusion `" AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'"`. That is the same filter the sales order and invoice entries use. I also updated that entry's comment and the Javadoc on `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` to say cancelled orders aren't counted.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
